svg.title: Сгибание кисти и локтя с эспандером — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing combined wrist and elbow curl with a long elastic resistance band clearly pinned under both shoes; thin continuous band drawn up to the hands, no dumbbell, bar or machine. LEFT nearly straight arms by sides, palms face forward, wrists neutral. RIGHT elbows bent about 90 degrees with upper arms still at sides, forearms in front with palms up, hands visibly flexed gently toward inner forearms at wrist. Show a real grip on the band and increased tension. Feet and band anchor in exactly same place in both poses. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
